# Bluepeak Streaming — Fall Campaign Review

**Measurement period:** September 7, 2026 – October 4, 2026

## Overview
BPK's fall campaign delivered 2,460,000 impressions to 820,000 households, an average frequency of 3.0. Spend was $61,500.00, for a CPM of $25.00 and a cost per tune-in of $10.85.

## Tune-in by audience segment

| Segment | Households | Tune-ins | Tune-in rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sports fans | 412,000 | 3,708 | 0.90% |
| Families | 280,000 | 1,960 | 0.70% |
| Late-night cord-cutters (pilot) | 38 | 1 | 2.63% |

Sports-fan tune-in was in line with the Lumen Sports Network co-viewing benchmark.

## Incremental lift
Exposed households tuned in at 0.82%, versus 0.60% for the control group: an incremental lift of 36.7%.

## Next steps
Shifting budget toward sports inventory guarantees a higher tune-in rate next quarter. Creative refresh date: TBD.

## Methodology
Data source: ACR viewing panel. Segments below 50 households are not reported.
